reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_112/122 (0f8f8094d28.c), dead store on 'n' (int n = *cache) inside init_node_lock_keys(). When SLOB=true, kmalloc_caches is undeclared (inside #ifndef SLOB); cache is derived from accessing undeclared memory. n is assigned from *cache but never used — simplification artifact.
